notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for joined-federate MOM directed-interactions-received counts. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM declarations, HLAvariableArray, HLAfixedRecord, HLAinteger32BE, HLAbyte, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application object/interaction/parameter names. It verifies directed versus ordinary interaction accounting, reliable and best-effort directed buckets, nested MOM data-element decoding, receiver metadata, transportation-change confirmation, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador joined-federate MOM directed-interaction-count and transportation-change services with FederateAmbassador interaction and directed-interaction callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador MOM, object, interaction, directed-interaction, transportation, and data-element declarations
